page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.48xlarge is a high-capacity, storage-optimized bare-metal equivalent virtual instance powered by the AWS Nitro System. Built on the 64-bit ARMv9 architecture, it features custom AWS Neoverse-V2 Graviton processors providing 192 dedicated physical cores and 192 vCPUs at a base clock of 2.7 GHz without simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 1536 GB of system memory, delivering an allocation of 8 GB per physical core, alongside a baseline network throughput of 300 Gbps. Bundled directly into the hardware configuration is 120,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, engineered for high-throughput, low-latency I/O operations without attached GPUs.

Synthetic and application-level benchmarks illustrate strong multi-threaded and memory-intensive execution profiles. Multi-core compute performance sits in the top tier, reflected in a stress-ng multi-core score of 311,538.24 and rapid Clang software compilation benchmarks. Memory subsystems show sustained bandwidth reaching 895.12 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 410.26 GB/sec for writes. Database execution tests, such as PassMark database operations and multi-threaded compression algorithms, rank in the top percentile, complemented by Redis SET benchmarks exceeding 356 million operations per second. In contrast, single-core execution metrics and vector-dependent tasks like image processing demonstrate average or weaker relative performance due to conservative per-core clock rates and the absence of specialized x86 vector extensions.

The hardware distribution provides high resource density for organizations aggregating large dataset processing into centralized nodes. Bundling 120 TB of local NVMe storage with 1.5 TB of memory eliminates network storage bottlenecks, optimizing resource expenditure for I/O-bound data architectures. Workloads best suited for this instance include distributed NoSQL databases, transactional data warehouses, large-scale Redis in-memory caches, Apache Kafka ingestion pipelines, and real-time big data processing platforms.
description: Amazon Web Services i8ge.48xlarge is a storage-optimized instance built on the Nitro System with 64-bit ARMv9 AWS Neoverse-V2 Graviton processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores and 192 vCPUs running at 2.7 GHz, 1536 GB of RAM, and 120,000 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage without integrated GPUs. Designed for high data throughput, the instance delivers a 300 Gbps network baseline and top-tier multi-core computing capability, demonstrating notable throughput in memory-heavy metrics like 895.12 GB/sec uncached reads and PassMark database operations. While single-thread speeds and specialized image processing tasks register at moderate levels, the dense 8 GB per core ratio and high local storage footprint offer qualitative cost efficiency by consolidating large data stores on single instances. The i8ge.48xlarge is suited for distributed data storage, transactional databases, high-capacity caching layers, and large-scale data stream ingestion.
